evidence.title: U.S. sanctions against the A/I Collective

summary: The U.S. Treasury announced sanctions against the AI Collective, a coalition of artificial‑intelligence firms accused of enabling illicit activities and violating export controls. The action freezes the group’s assets, bans U.S. transactions, and signals tighter regulatory scrutiny of AI collaborations.
title: U.S. Imposes Sanctions on AI Collective Over Alleged Misuse of Technology
